text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=llm-inference, version=v3.2.0, target=20% traffic, change_window=2024-02-02T22:00Z. rolling in 5min. https://deploys.redwood.internal/roll/1736004321 :rocket:
alex: noted. grabbing metrics dashboards.
maria: quick heads up — saw a small spike in tail latency on a sample of canaries last night. not sure if related to model change, investigating. :mag:
sre_oncall: if latency goes >1200ms P95 we should pause. set alert window to 10m.
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck: passed 96/100 (5m). kernel mem stable. starting traffic shift now.
kevin: running a quick compatibility check for embedding schema — ping if anything surfaces.
maria: seeing a few 502s on eu-west edge, small spike coincident with shift start (approx +0.6%).
alex: can you paste logs? especially kv-cache OOM traces.
maria: ```
[2024-02-02T22:07:05Z] kvcache: evict=12 free=82% used=18%
[2024-02-02T22:08:12Z] proxy: upstream 10.4.7.8 502 "read reset"
[2024-02-02T22:08:15Z] router: tail-latency P95=980ms -> 1250ms
```
sre_oncall: ok that's borderline. ops, can we clamp rollout at 10% and run an extra 10m observation?
deploy-bot: updating rollout target -> 10% (manual clamp by @sre_oncall). traffic shift paused at 10%.
kevin: suggestion: pin v3.1.8 for eu-west route until we sort kv-cache behavior. we can keep global 10% and route eu-west to stable.
alex: +1 on regional pin. requires deploy config change: `route_override: eu-west->v3.1.8` — should be quick.
release-manager: note: if we pin regionally we need to log the change in the release notes and notify customers in the change window. update the changelog entry?
maria: testing a quick rollback on one EU instance now. will report in 2m.
sre_oncall: given latency + 502s, recommendation = rollback global to v3.1.8 and reopen canary after patch. requesting stop/go vote.
alex: vote: STOP (rollback).
maria: vote: STOP. results look correlated to routing.
kevin: vote: STOP, will follow up on cache tuning patch.
release-manager: vote: STOP. I'll update release notes and schedule a postmortem.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. initiating rollback to v3.1.8 across affected pools. command: ```/deploy rollback --service llm-inference --to v3.1.8 --scope regional:eu-west,global```
deploy-bot: rollback started. estimated completion ~3m. will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sre_oncall: taking oncall handoff for the rest of the hour to monitor. setting an incident stub in PagerDuty.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic reverted. canary healthcheck: 100/100.
maria: post-rollback check: tail latency back to baseline, 502s cleared.
alex: recording follow-up tasks: 1) KV cache investigation and repro, 2) test harness for regional routing, 3) clarification in deploy docs about soft-clamps.
release-manager: I'll update release notes with "regional pin due to eu-west proxy instability; rollback executed" and send an email to customers in the change window tomorrow.
kevin: I'll open a PR with cache tuning + telemetry. tagging @maria for logs.
maria: thanks. assigning to infra/serving for Monday.
sre_oncall: closing the stop/go — consensus to STOP and rollback. if anyone wants the incident log, ping me. :white_check_mark:
release-manager: adding a short blurb to the deployment ticket and scheduling a 30m postmortem sync for 2024-02-03 15:00Z.
alex: ok. let's only reattempt a staged rollout after cache patch + canary pass.
deploy-bot: thread closed by action: rollback. archive TTL=30d.
